d: Two skydivers are rushed in, a bride-to-be gets her finger stuck in a make-up jar and more.

st: A Real Pain in the Neck
d: A man is rushed to the ER with a 16-inch bar protruding from his neck.
Another day, another surprise pregnancy. A woman in the ER discusses whether she's ready to be a mother.

A teenage football player suffers a stroke in the ER. A renowned doctor recounts his first major trauma as a resident in the 1970s. A doctor tries to solve the mysteries of a patient with abdominal pain and a man who was run over twice by his wife.
A pregnant woman's leg pain turns out to be a flesh-eating virus, threatening life and limb.
A paralyzed stroke patient watches in horror as his wife and his two girlfriends fight over him.
A woman complaining of abdominal pain finds out that she is in fact pregnant.
Doctors use a robot operated by a specialist at another hospital to treat a seizing 7-year-old boy. A chef's tongue is swelling. A woman who crashed her car insists her injured dog be treated first.
